Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper around the FindHighest specification. It introduces two constants, MaxLength and MaxNat, and constrains the explored behaviors by bounding the length of the sequence f and restricting naturals to the finite range 0..MaxNat. The module defines helper operators for the model, including a bounded natural set and a constructor for all sequences over a set S, but it does not define actions, temporal behavior, or proofs in this file.
